## W05A Risk and control record

W05A   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: inherent and residual risk are both recorded with their evidence basis; every claimed reduction rests on a control marked Verified in W14 or is shown as unverified; and the decision names its authority, conditions and review trigger.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

Duplicate for each material risk. Use the Client risk method and record its scale and definitions. Link objective, risk, control, test, evidence and decision IDs.

Assessment ID ________  Objective ID ________  Risk ID ________  Control ID ________

**Scenario and inherent risk before controls**

Cause, event, affected people and consequence; likelihood, impact, speed of harm, confidence and evidence basis.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Response and control mechanism**

Avoid, mitigate, transfer or accept. Describe the actual preventive, detective or responsive action; owner, trigger/frequency, approver and dependency.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Implementation and operating evidence**

Control design reference; deployed configuration/procedure; test ID; observed behavior; verifier/date; evidence status.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Residual risk and uncertainty**

Reassess after verified controls. Unverified controls cannot justify the same reduction as demonstrated controls. Name material unknowns and the next evidence request.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Decision and conditions**

Risk acceptance authority, decision/date, restrictions, action owner, resources, due date, review trigger and W10/W23 reference.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Benefit does not compensate for a prohibited use or failed mandatory control. A risk score is meaningful only with its assumptions, evidence and authorized response.
